description: This line plot illustrates the impact of the hyperparameter N on the AUC (%) metric, with N ranging from 0 to 20 along the linear x-axis and AUC (%) ranging from 75 to 100 along the linear y-axis. Five distinct lines represent different conditions or models: a blue line with circular markers, an orange line with diamond markers, a green line with star markers, a red line with square markers, and a purple line with triangle markers. The blue line starts at approximately 94% AUC at N=0, rises to 100% at N=10, and then declines to about 94% at N=20. The orange line begins at approximately 84% AUC at N=0, increases to about 95% at N=10, and then slightly decreases to about 94% at N=20. The green line starts at approximately 87% AUC at N=0, rises to about 93% at N=10, and then slightly declines to about 92% at N=20. The red line begins at approximately 88% AUC at N=0, increases to 100% at N=10, and then declines to about 91% at N=20. The purple line remains relatively flat at approximately 80% AUC from N=0 to N=5, then sharply increases to 96% at N=10, and subsequently declines to about 83% at N=20.
